objective: 建立 local profile 下可重复执行、可版本维护的统一 mock 数据源。
non_goals: 修改业务 API 和现有业务逻辑
写入 Flowable ACT_* 引擎表
生产环境自动灌入演示数据
将纯前端交付示范会话状态迁移到后端
decisions: JSON is the maintained source; loader uses a table and column allowlist.
Local-only opt-in synchronization runs after Flyway through ApplicationRunner.
Rows use deterministic high IDs and upsert semantics; no destructive cleanup is performed.
Dataset version and SHA-256 are recorded in sys_mock_dataset_state.
risks: Local restart overwrites rows owned by the mock dataset; disable the switch before manual data exploration.
New backend tables require an allowlist entry and data contract update before they can be seeded.
